items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: "'If I Had A Ribbon Bos, 'Lock Lochman and 'Jackie Boy,' they're entirely different arrangements altogether."

ctx.x: They had been doing some things on their own. They were studio musicians, and they were creating a style -- you know, The New Friends of Rhythm.

I thought they were very modern. The arrangements were sort of strange, maybe because as you'll notice, lot of the things like "If I Had A Ribbon Bos, "Lock Lochman and "Jackie Boy," they're entirely different arrangements altogether.
